Infrastructure and Deployment

The cloud infrastructure for this project is provisioned using Terraform.

Core Resources

The Terraform configuration creates and manages:

  • Amazon S3 bucket for processed datasets

  • Athena database

  • Athena workgroup

  • relevant output values and metadata

S3 Structure

The bucket is structured for both data storage and query output:

s3://<bucket-name>/
├── processed/
│   ├── maintenance_cleaned.csv
│   └── maintenance_dealer_joined.csv
└── athena-results/

Athena configuration

The Athena workgroup is configured to write query results to the athena-results prefix in S3. This allows query outputs to be stored in a dedicated location and kept separate from the raw and processed dataset folders.
